      public RemovePlaylistItemsRequest.Builder items(List<String> items)
      The items body parameter setter.
      Parameters:
      items - Required. An array of objects containing Spotify URIs of the tracks or episodes to remove. For example: { "items": [{ "uri": "spotify:track:4iV5W9uYEdYUVa79Axb7Rh" },{ "uri": "spotify:track:1301WleyT98MSxVHPZCA6M" }] }. A maximum of 100 objects can be sent at once.       The snapshot_id body parameter setter.
